subject: Reasoning
description: Missing-number patterns, magic squares, multi-rule grid puzzles, deduction with numbers

questions.explanation: Differences: 4, 6, 8, 10 (arithmetic progression). Next difference = 12. So 30 + 12 = 42. Equivalently each term = n(n+1) for n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 → 2, 6, 12, 20, 30; next n=6 gives 42. Distractor 36 = 6². Distractor 40 = 30 + 10 (uses last difference instead of next). Distractor 48 = 30 + 18 (jumped two steps in difference).

questions.explanation: Pattern: each term = previous × 2 + 1. Verify: 5×2+1 = 11; 11×2+1 = 23; 23×2+1 = 47; 47×2+1 = 95; 95×2+1 = 191. Distractor 143 from 95 + 48 (broken pattern). Distractor 185 = 95 × 2 − 5 (wrong adjustment). Distractor 181 = 95 × 2 − 9 (wrong adjustment).

options.option_text: 16, the smallest of the listed numbers
50, the only non-perfect-square in the set
64, an even number among the squares
100, the largest of the listed numbers

questions.explanation: 16 = 4², 25 = 5², 36 = 6², 64 = 8², 81 = 9², 100 = 10² — perfect squares. 50 is NOT a perfect square (√50 ≈ 7.07). Distractor 1 — smallest, but it IS a square. Distractor 3 — being even doesn't make 64 odd-one-out. Distractor 4 — largest, but is a square.

questions.stem: What number replaces the question mark in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: Series of perfect squares: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5² → next is 6² = 36. Distractor 30 from 25 + 5 (added next position number). Distractor 32 = 25 + 7 (wrong difference). Distractor 49 = 7² (skipped 6²).

questions.explanation: Series of consecutive perfect squares: 11² = 121, 12² = 144, 13² = 169, 14² = 196, 15² = 225. Distractor 210 = 196 + 14 (added next root, ignored squaring). Distractor 220 = 196 + 24 (wrong difference). Distractor 256 = 16² (skipped 15²).

questions.stem: In the sequence 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, ?, the next number is:
questions.explanation: Pattern: each term = previous × 2 − 1. Verify: 3×2−1 = 5; 5×2−1 = 9; 9×2−1 = 17; 17×2−1 = 33; 33×2−1 = 65. Distractor 60 from 33 + 27 (doubled wrongly). Distractor 55 from 33 + 22. Distractor 67 = 33×2 + 1 (wrong sign).

questions.stem:
Find the missing number in the magic square (each row and column sums to the same value):
Row 1: 8, 1, 6
Row 2: 3, 5, 7
Row 3: 4, 9, ?
questions.explanation: Row 1 sum: 8+1+6 = 15. Magic square has all rows + columns + diagonals summing to 15. Row 3: 4 + 9 + ? = 15 → ? = 2. Verify column 3: 6+7+2 = 15 ✓. Distractor 1 = swap with row-1 middle. Distractor 3 from row-2 first entry. Distractor 5 from middle of row 2. This is the famous Lo Shu magic square.
